ref_entities: create a python module that uses ArticulatedObjectStateSampler to sample and apply uniform joint states for matching articulated objects in a Habitat simulator scene
create a python module that uses ArtObjCatStateSampler to sample discrete categorical joint states from a predefined range for articulated objects in a Habitat simulator
create a python module that uses CompositeArticulatedObjectStateSampler to iteratively sample multiple joint states with rejection sampling and contact validation across articulated objects
review the python module ArticulatedObjectStateSampler and its sample method that finds matching articulated objects by handle substring and applies sampled joint positions
refactor the python CompositeArticulatedObjectStateSampler to improve the iterative rejection sampling loop that validates configurations via contact tests and collision detection
create an ObjectSampler to sample objects from a set and place them on receptacles in a Habitat simulator scene
sample a receptacle from the receptacle set with optional tilt culling and gravity alignment constraints
attempt to place a sampled object on a receptacle with collision testing and navmesh accessibility checks
sample a single object placement by selecting a receptacle then an object and attempting placement
run the full sampling loop to place multiple objects on receptacles with configurable min and max counts
create an ObjectTargetSampler instance with a list of ManagedRigidObject instances for target sampling
call sample on ObjectTargetSampler to place objects into target receptacles within the Habitat simulator
review the ObjectTargetSampler sample method to understand how it maps instances without replacement
refactor the ObjectTargetSampler sample method to add custom validation for target and goal receptacle counts
summarize the ObjectTargetSampler class which extends ObjectSampler to sample from specific object instances instead of templates
find all receptacles defined in the scene metadata for currently instanced rigid and articulated objects
parse receptacle metadata from a user subconfig and construct AABBReceptacle or TriangleMeshReceptacle objects
import triangle mesh data from a mesh file using magnum trade importer and return MeshData objects
filter a list of receptacles to return only those navigable from the largest indoor navmesh island
allocate one object placement to a receptacle and decrement its remaining allocation counter
create a SingleSceneSampler with a scene path string and call sample to return it
create a MultiSceneSampler with a list of scene paths and sample random scenes uniformly
create a BalancedSceneSampler with scene list and episode count to evenly distribute episodes across scenes
call sample on any SceneSampler subclass to get the next scene string for episode generation
call set_cur_episode on BalancedSceneSampler to advance which scene is returned by subsequent sample calls
